context.blocks:
- declare {name: variable} as {value: variant}: A shorthand block that declares a new variable and assigns it a value immediately.
- {name: variable} {op: +=,-=,*=,/=,//=,%=} {value: variant}: Python's assignment operators: total += 5 is total = total + 5, and -=, *=, /=, //= and %= work the same way with their sign. The variable must already have a value. Follows the Math block's rules, so += also joins text.
- for each {name: variable} in {list: list}: Runs the blocks inside once for every item of a list, in order. The variable holds a copy of the item, so changing the variable doesn't change the list.
- {file}.write({text}): Python's f.write(): adds the text to the end of a file as a new line. It takes text only; a number has to be made text with str() or an f-string first.
- open("poem.txt"): The text file poem.txt, shown in the room. Python opens it with open("poem.txt"). Drop it into any block that needs a file.
- open("numbered.txt"): The text file numbered.txt, shown in the room. Python opens it with open("numbered.txt"). Drop it into any block that needs a file.
